0022600038.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-8, 3-4 at home, 12th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (7-4, 5-0 on the road, 9th in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, New Orleans' 13th of the season. The Pelicans have lost four straight, while Memphis has lost one. New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), both out, and Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Bryce McGowens (elbow infection) and Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Memphis is without Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), both out, and Quinten Post (head) is day-to-day with a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Pelicans lead the 2026-27 series 1-0 after a 135-134 win in Memphis on November 2.
